sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; SkillCenter ranked first after recent-topic exclusions and exact latest-data dedupe.
Main agent read arXiv metadata, PDF, TeX source, GitHub README, repository code entrypoints, tests, and current anonymous-access limits for HF paper/dataset pages.
Article decomposes SkillGate, template generation, iterative grounding, publish gates, SQLite FTS5 retrieval, downstream A/B results, real-skill probe, dedupe, quality, licensing, and safety scans.
Analysis separates full-library and pipeline-subset counts, treats LLM quality scores as internal QA, flags title-only retrieval failure, and distinguishes source grounding from factual verification.
Related positions include RAG chunks, Voyager-style online skills, Self-Instruct, ClawHub, community skill marketplaces, and prompt-injection/tool-use safety work cited by the paper.
Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs are embedded and Chinese character count exceeds 5000.
